name: Podcast Frame — Talking Head
description: Static podcast-style medium shot of a speaker with warm studio depth behind them.
thumbnailPrompt: medium shot of a speaker at a podcast microphone, warm studio background, shallow depth

inputs.label: Speaker description
inputs.placeholder: confident woman in her 30s wearing a dark blazer

promptTemplate: Locked-off medium shot, podcast studio: {subject} speaking naturally to an off-camera host, {topicEnergy} delivery with believable micro-expressions, natural head movement and hand gestures. Studio digital S35 camera, 85mm portrait prime at f/2.0, creamy background bokeh with warm practical lamps and acoustic panels, broadcast-quality three-point lighting, gentle rim light separating the speaker, realistic skin texture, professional interview framing with headroom on the rule of thirds.
negativePrompt: camera movement, warped face, dead eyes, extra teeth, plastic skin, text, watermark, audience

referenceImages.hint: A portrait of the speaker keeps identity consistent.
